Hello, I'ma television reporter. May I ask you some questions?

Seventeen candidates are competing for seven positions.
How do you feel about the election?
We feel very excited today.

Sure. One of our candidates, Sadia, is coming this way.

3.1 Language Focus: Simple Future Tense
In the dialogue, Sadia used the following sentences—
I'll assist the teachers to make our school a better place.
I'll also try to keep the school clean.
By using the expressions will assist, will try, Sadia means to do some
actions in future after winning the election.

subject: English
text:
We use the Simple Future Tense to say what will happen later. We use
the following structure for the Simple Future Tense.
Subject | Auxiliary verb Rest of the sentence
. . the teachers to make our
I will assist
school a better place.
More examples:
a) I will visit my uncle's house next weekend.
b) He will finish his homework by tomorrow.

d) We will go to the museum by bus next week.
e) They will distribute clothes to the poor.
